sections.heading: 1. Calf raises + towel scrunch
lines: ① Stand tall, hands on a wall.
② Rise up only to a comfortable height.
③ 10 reps × 2 sets, once a day.
④ Seated, scrunch a towel with your toes 10×.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: The toe is hot, red and very swollen,
or pain wakes you at night.

slides.title:

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Every time Koko pushes off, her big toe jabs. A stiff, sore big toe joint is common, tends to build over years and usually goes up and down with load.

Footwear is often the quickest win. A firmer or gently rocker-shaped sole means the toe bends less each step, while thongs and very bendy sneakers can make it grumpier. Calf raises to a comfortable height and toe exercises help the foot share the load.

A hot, red, very swollen toe, night pain, numbness or a sudden change after an injury is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help you keep walking comfortably. Book online via the link in bio.
